items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: borrow from a white man who come through there who used to write for Paul Whiteman

ctx.x: to leave in the next day or so, I didn't pay no attention. I picked the music up in the bag, and ...(?). He just went in the bag and stole the music, (?)half the arrangements(?). We got on to Virginia and found out somebody had been in and stole some of our best arrangements out of there. So I think we had to borrow from a white man who come through there who used to write for Paul Whiteman -- he fixed them up for us.
